title: Cleansing from Sin / The Shepherd Struck

questions.question: "On that day there shall be a fountain opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:1 (ESV): "On that day there shall be a fountain opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and uncleanness."

questions.question: "And on that day, declares the Lord of hosts, I will cut off the names of the... from the land, so that they shall be remembered no more."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:2 (ESV): "I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, so that they shall be remembered no more."

questions.question: "...and also I will remove from the land the... and the spirit of uncleanness."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:2 (ESV): "and also I will remove from the land the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness."

questions.question: If anyone again prophesies, what will his father and mother say to him?
options: 'You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord.'
'Go to the priests and confess your sin.'
questions.correctAnswer: 'You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord.'
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:3 (ESV): "his father and mother who bore him will say to him, 'You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord.'"

questions.question: What will the father and mother do to the false prophet when he prophesies?
options: They will report him to the elders
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:3 (ESV): "And his father and mother who bore him shall pierce him through when he prophesies."

questions.question: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies. He will not put on a... in order to deceive,"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:4 (ESV): "He will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive,"

questions.question: What will the false prophet say he is instead of a prophet?
options: 'I am a worker of the soil'
'I am a priest of the Lord'
questions.correctAnswer: 'I am a worker of the soil'
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:5 (ESV): "but he will say, 'I am no prophet, I am a worker of the soil, for a man sold me in my youth.'"

questions.question: And if one asks him, 'What are these wounds on your back?' what will he say?
options: 'The wounds I received in the house of my friends.'
questions.correctAnswer: 'The wounds I received in the house of my friends.'
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:6 (ESV): "he will say, 'The wounds I received in the house of my friends.'"

questions.question: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who stands next to me," declares the Lord of hosts. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:7 (ESV): "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered;"

questions.question: "...I will turn my hand against the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:7 (ESV): "I will turn my hand against the little ones."

questions.question: "In the whole land, declares the Lord, two thirds shall be cut off and perish, and one third shall be..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:8 (ESV): "two thirds shall be cut off and perish, and one third shall be left alive."

questions.question: "And I will put this third into the fire, and refine them as one refines silver, and test them as..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:9 (ESV): "and refine them as one refines silver, and test them as gold is tested."

questions.question: "They will call upon my name, and I will..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:9 (ESV): "They will call upon my name, and I will answer them."

questions.question: "I will say, 'They are my people'; and they will say, 'The Lord is my...'"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:9 (ESV): "and they will say, 'The Lord is my God.'"

questions.question: Who spoke the prophecy: "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 13:7 (ESV): "'Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered;' declares the Lord of hosts."

key_verse_text: And I will put this third into the fire, and refine them as one refines silver, and test them as gold is tested. They will call upon my name, and I will answer them. I will say, 'They are my people'; and they will say, 'The Lord is my God.'
